mapper.sql: newsletter_id, week_start_date, headline, financial_words_json, issues_json, stats_json, status, generation_type, created_by, published_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM newsletters WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM newsletters WHERE week_start_date = #{weekStartDate} ORDER BY created_at DESC
